rationale.consistency: Follows surrounding style: small helper funcs, same comment voice, byte-indexed loop, same escape guard (len >= i+3) as prefix code; gofmt-clean.
rationale.edge_cases: Decoded suffix vs %2F/%62 paths, literal %xx suffix, empty suffix, suffix equal to whole path, and positions inside escapes are all handled; prefix behaviour is byte-for-byte preserved via -1/len mapping.
rationale.scope: Only the suffix path changes; extracting matchPathPrefix is the minimal refactor to share logic. Removing now-dead reverse() is reasonable cleanup but slightly beyond the strict ask.
rationale.readability: Clear names (matchPathPrefix/trimPathSuffix), explanatory doc comment on why every start position is tried and why escapes are skipped; logic is easy to follow.
rationale.robustness: No new panics: slicing guarded by length checks, PathUnescape error path propagates as -1; O(n*m) scan is bounded by path length.
rationale.maintainability: Single shared comparison routine for prefix and suffix eliminates the reverse-string hack and any future divergence between the two rules.
